_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Passage (Quest)#001.src: My dad said I can't let any strangers through this passage!
The Passage (Quest)#001.dst: 我爸說了，我不能讓任何陌生人通過這條通道！
The Passage (Quest)#001.speaker: Wirt

The Passage (Quest)#002.src: If you want access, talk to him, he's the recruiter of the town! His name is Ildan. He's just southwest of here.
The Passage (Quest)#002.dst: 你要想過去，去找他談。他是鎮上的招募官！他叫 Ildan，就在這裡的西南邊。
The Passage (Quest)#002.speaker: Wirt

The Passage (Quest)#003.src: Find Ildan in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask to be a member of the town
The Passage (Quest)#003.dst: 在 {p} 的 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找到 Ildan，請求成為鎮上的一員

The Passage (Quest)#004.src: Oh! So you want to become a member of this town?
The Passage (Quest)#004.dst: 哦！所以你想成為這個鎮的一員？
The Passage (Quest)#004.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#005.src: You will have to help us first, of course!
The Passage (Quest)#005.dst: 那當然得先幫我們一個忙！
The Passage (Quest)#005.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#006.src: They used to have a powerful chief, but he eventually died in battle.
The Passage (Quest)#006.dst: 他們以前有位很強的酋長，後來戰死了。
The Passage (Quest)#006.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#007.src: The tribe couldn't bear the fact that he was dead. They performed some unethical necromancy spell on him.
The Passage (Quest)#007.dst: 部落無法接受他的死，於是對他施了某種不該碰的死靈術。
The Passage (Quest)#007.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#008.src: He keeps reviving his minions and it's causing quite some problems to our army.
The Passage (Quest)#008.dst: 他不斷把手下復活，給我們的軍隊帶來不少麻煩。
The Passage (Quest)#008.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#009.src: You can access the tomb from a sacrificial shrine, I've heard, but I'm not sure how. There are probably hints nearby the shrine.
The Passage (Quest)#009.dst: 我聽說可以從一座獻祭神壇進入那座墓穴，但我不確定怎麼進。神壇附近應該會有提示。
The Passage (Quest)#009.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#010.src: Bring me back [{~} Antic Bead] as a proof of its death, and I will let you become a citizen.
The Passage (Quest)#010.dst: 把 [{~} 古怪珠子] 帶回來給我當作牠已死的憑證，我就讓你成為鎮民。
The Passage (Quest)#010.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#011.src: I've marked the direction to the shrine in your book. Remember, there should be hints right nearby the shrine. Good luck.
The Passage (Quest)#011.dst: 我把神壇的方向標在你的書上了。記住，提示就在神壇附近。祝你好運。
The Passage (Quest)#011.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#012.src: Search for clues near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Antic Bead] to Ildan.
The Passage (Quest)#012.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 附近尋找線索，並把 [{~4} 古怪珠子] 帶回給 Ildan。

The Passage (Quest)#013.dst: 厲害！你把珠子拿到手了！
The Passage (Quest)#013.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#014.src: Well, welcome to this town, adventurer! You are now officially a citizen.
The Passage (Quest)#014.dst: 那麼，歡迎來到這個鎮，冒險者！你正式成為鎮民了。
The Passage (Quest)#014.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#015.src: Oh, but before you go! I do have a few things to say. First, about the beads here.
The Passage (Quest)#015.dst: 哦，不過在你走之前！我還有幾件事要說。第一，關於這裡的珠子。
The Passage (Quest)#015.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#016.src: The tribesmen accept these as currency, so if you collect enough, I've heard they can offer you powerful masks.
The Passage (Quest)#016.dst: 部落的人把這些當貨幣用，所以你要是收集得夠多，聽說他們可以給你強力的面具。
The Passage (Quest)#016.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#017.src: Second, about the shrine. Now, this is just a rumor, but apparently that tomb is not unique.
The Passage (Quest)#017.dst: 第二，關於那座神壇。這只是傳聞，但那座墓穴似乎不是唯一的一座。
The Passage (Quest)#017.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#018.src: There are supposed to be a bunch of these altars scattered around the province, even in Gavel too!
The Passage (Quest)#018.dst: 據說這種祭壇散布在整個行省，連 Gavel 那邊都有！
The Passage (Quest)#018.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#019.src: If true, you should look for them. While the fights will be tough, I would imagine great rewards could be gotten from them!
The Passage (Quest)#019.dst: 如果是真的，你應該去找找看。那些戰鬥會很硬，但我猜報酬也會很可觀！
The Passage (Quest)#019.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#020.src: Anyway, I've talked enough. I'm proud to have such a powerful fighter join our town! I wish you luck, friend!
The Passage (Quest)#020.dst: 好了，我話說夠多了。有你這樣的強者加入我們鎮，我很驕傲！祝你好運，朋友！
The Passage (Quest)#020.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#021.dst: 外來者！殺了那些外來者！

The Passage (Quest)#023.src: I'm sure you've noticed, but there is a tribe camp not far from here.
The Passage (Quest)#023.dst: 你一定注意到了，離這裡不遠處有個部落營地。
The Passage (Quest)#023.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#024.src: They quickly realised that it was a bad idea, so they locked him in a tomb.
The Passage (Quest)#024.dst: 他們很快就發現那是個壞主意，於是把他鎖進了一座墓穴裡。
The Passage (Quest)#024.speaker: Ildan

The Passage (Quest)#025.src: Have you found the shrine yet? I've heard that throwing something as tribute to it could do the trick... There should be clues about what it might be near the shrine.
The Passage (Quest)#025.dst: 你找到那座神龕了嗎？我聽說丟點什麼東西當作貢品也許就行得通…… 神龕附近應該會有線索，告訴你那該是什麼。

The Passage (Quest)#026.src: Sorry man, if you haven't got any business with me then I can't talk.
The Passage (Quest)#026.speaker: Troms Citizen 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿢 󐀂

The Passage (Quest)#027.src: Well... I'm glad it worked out for you.

The Passage (Quest)#029.src: Have you heard tales about the great General Skien? Many years ago, he led the Tromsian Army into battle.
The Passage (Quest)#029.dst: 你聽過偉大的 Skien 將軍的故事嗎？多年以前，他率領 Tromsian 軍隊上了戰場。
The Passage (Quest)#029.speaker:
Troms Citizen
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Passage (Quest)#030.src: But what is most famous about him is not stories of victory, but rather something much more mysterious.
The Passage (Quest)#030.dst: 不過他最出名的不是打勝仗的事蹟，而是一件神祕得多的事。
The Passage (Quest)#030.speaker:
Troms Citizen
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

The Passage (Quest)#031.src: One day, Skien started acting very strange, and he vanished along with the entire Tromsian Army.
The Passage (Quest)#031.dst: 有一天，Skien 的舉止開始變得非常古怪，然後就連同整支 Tromsian 軍隊一起消失了。
